summary: Groups are not first-class in Ansible, just labels for host selection and bulk variable assignment, so read a group variable through a host in that group.
questions: How do I read a variable defined in group_vars for a group?
Can I access group variables directly?

answer_card.title: Access group variables
answer_card.answer_md:
You can't read a group's vars directly; groups are just labels. Read them through a host in the group:

```jinja
{{ hostvars[groups['webservers'][0]]['my_group_var'] }}
```
